name: ICONSIAM
slides: Siam Piwat, Magnolia Quality Development and Charoen Pokphand Group built it on a 55-rai plot on Charoen Nakhon Road.
Magnolia Waterfront Residences in the complex has 70 floors and rises 317.95 m – the tallest building in Thailand.
Arrive by boat or Gold Line
Four piers on site serve private boats and public ferries. The Gold Line's Charoen Nakhon station is right next door.
caption:
A 54-billion-baht mall on the river 🇹🇭

ICONSIAM opened on the banks of the Chao Phraya in November 2018 with 525,000 m² of retail space. Next to it rises Thailand's tallest building, and four piers let you arrive by boat. 🚤

Would you come by boat or by train? 👇
